text:
yara: Strange edge-case during onboarding: with JSON_MODE + function-calls, the TS helper coerces empty objects to `null` for optional params to save tokens. Downstream Ajv validator in sample-kit rejects it because the schema expects an object (nullable) with required subkeys. Repro below.

ben: Oof. Can you paste the tiny repro and schema? Which SDK version?

yara: Repro steps:
1) clone sample-kit/optional-opts && cd optional-opts
2) JSON_MODE=1 node quickstart.js
3) send generate that triggers tool `render_preview` with params `{options?: {width:number,theme:string}}`

Observed: TS quickstart prints `function_call.arguments = { options: null }` whereas the handler expects an object and validator errors: `missing required property: theme`. Python quickstart sends `{ options: {} }` and handler applies defaults.

dom: Wait, where is the coercion coming from? We do have a tiny optimization in serializer to compress empty objects -> null when opt-in (serializer.compact = true). That was added to reduce token cost for large fleets. Didn't realize it would hit required-subkey validations.

yara: Right — user didn't include theme in the payload because it's optional, but their sample-validator (Ajv) has `required: ['theme']` under options to force explicit presence. So `null` fails.

ben: Quick mitigation: sample-kit should apply Ajv defaults / coerce null -> {} when schema expects object to avoid blocking onboarding. But that's a bandaid.

dom: Agreed. Two follow-ups: 1) revert the default-on behavior of compacting empty objects in the SDK (or make it opt-in behind an env var), 2) add a serializer test that ensures we don't turn empty objects into null for schemas that require properties. Also add a CLI lint that warns when a schema marks subkeys required but the quickstart's handler contradicts that (common source of confusion).

build-bot: Issue created: DEVEX-2010 "ts-sdk: compact serializer converts empty object -> null breaking required subkey validators in sample-kit" (labels: bug, onboarding, test-needed).

yara: I pushed a tiny sample-kit shim that treats `options: null` as `{}` for now and logs a warning pointing at DEVEX-2010. That unblocks the user's onboarding flow.

dom: I'll open a PR to change the serializer: default to preserving empty objects; add `serializer.compactEmptyObjects=true/false` option for power users. Also adding unit tests: round-trip object -> not-null and parity test vs Python.

ben: Also add an e2e in sample-kit that runs quickstart with schema `options.required=['theme']` and asserts handler receives either explicit keys or the sample-kit injects defaults before validation. Prevents future regressions.

sdk-bot: Note: tag added DEVEX-2010 -> blocker for release v0.15.0; assigned to @dom.

yara: Thanks 44d. One more thought: we should update onboarding docs to call out serializer micro-optimizations (compactEmptyObjects, primitive coercion) and recommend turning them off for quickstarts. That will stop new users from hitting silent mismatches.

dom: Good idea. I'll add a short section in the SDK README and in the quickstart guide. Planning to land patch + tests today.

ben: If anyone wants to pair on the parity test I'll join this afternoon.

yara: Appreciate it 389. Marking DEVEX-2010 blocked->in-progress once PR lands.
